networks: flashsale-net: driver: bridge
volumes: postgres_data: mongo_data: redis_data: elastic_data: minio_data: kafka_data: zookeeper_data: axon_data:
services: # ================================================================= # 1. INFRASTRUCTURE (HẠ TẦNG DỮ LIỆU & MESSAGE QUEUE) # ================================================================= postgres: image: postgres:15-alpine container_name: fs-postgres ports: ["5432:5432"] environment: - POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres} - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-postgres123!} volumes: - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data - ../infra/postgres-init:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d networks: [flashsale-net] healthcheck: test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres"] interval: 30s timeout: 10s retries: 10 start_period: 80s
mongo: image: mongo:6.0 container_name: fs-mongo ports: ["27017:27017"] volumes: [mongo_data:/data/db] networks: [flashsale-net] healthcheck: test: ["CMD", "mongosh", "--eval", "db.runCommand('ping').ok"] interval: 30s timeout: 10s retries: 10 start_period: 80s
redis: image: redis:alpine container_name: fs-redis ports: ["6379:6379"] command: redis-server --appendonly yes volumes: [redis_data:/data] networks: [flashsale-net] healthcheck: test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"] interval: 30s timeout: 10s retries: 10 start_period: 80s
elasticsearch: image: elasticsearch:8.10.2 container_name: fs-elastic environment: - discovery.type=single-node - xpack.security.enabled=false - "ES_JAVA_OPTS=-Xms512m -Xmx512m" ports: ["9200:9200"] volumes: [elastic_data:/usr/share/elasticsearch/data] networks: [flashsale-net] healthcheck: test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f -s http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health > /dev/null || exit 1"] interval: 30s timeout: 10s retries: 10 start_period: 80s
minio: image: minio/minio:latest container_name: fs-minio ports: ["9000:9000", "9001:9001"] environment: - MINIO_ROOT_USER=${MINIO_ACCESS_KEY} - MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=${MINIO_SECRET_KEY} command: server /data --console-address ":9001" volumes: [minio_data:/data] networks: [flashsale-net]
zookeeper: image: confluentinc/cp-zookeeper:7.4.0 container_name: fs-zookeeper environment: ZOOKEEPER_CLIENT_PORT: 2181 ZOOKEEPER_SYNC_LIMIT: 5 ZOOKEEPER_INIT_LIMIT: 30 volumes: [zookeeper_data:/var/lib/zookeeper/data] networks: [flashsale-net] healthcheck: test: ["CMD", "bash", "-c", "echo ruok | timeout 1 bash -i >& /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/2181 && echo imok || exit 1"] interval: 30s timeout: 10s retries: 10 start_period: 60s healthcheck: test: ["CMD", "echo", "ruok", "|", "nc", "localhost", "2181"] interval: 10s timeout: 5s retries: 5 start_period: 10s
kafka: image: confluentinc/cp-kafka:7.4.0 container_name: fs-kafka depends_on: zookeeper: { condition: service_healthy } ports: ["9092:9092"] environment: KAFKA_BROKER_ID: 1 KAFKA_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECT: zookeeper:2181 KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://kafka:29092,PLAINTEXT_HOST://localhost:9092 KAFKA_LISTENER_SECURITY_PROTOCOL_MAP: PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,PLAINTEXT_HOST:PLAINTEXT KAFKA_INTER_BROKER_LISTENER_NAME: PLAINTEXT KAFKA_OFFSETS_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1 KAFKA_AUTO_CREATE_TOPICS_ENABLE: "false" KAFKA_LOG_CLEANUP_POLICY: delete KAFKA_LOG_RETENTION_HOURS: 168 KAFKA_LOG_SEGMENT_BYTES: 1073741824 KAFKA_CONFLUENT_METRICS_REPORTER_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS: kafka:29092 KAFKA_CONFLUENT_METRICS_REPORTER_TOPIC_REPLICAS: 1 KAFKA_CONFLUENT_LICENSE_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1 volumes: [kafka_data:/var/lib/kafka/data] networks: [flashsale-net] command: bash -c "rm -f /var/lib/kafka/data/meta.properties && rm -rf /var/lib/kafka/data/log-* && /etc/confluent/docker/run" healthcheck: test: ["CMD-SHELL", "nc -z localhost 9092 || exit 1"] interval: 10s timeout: 5s retries: 10 start_period: 40s
axonserver: image: axoniq/axonserver:latest container_name: fs-axon ports: ["8024:8024", "8124:8124"] environment: - AXONIQ_AXONSERVER_CONTEXTS=default - AXONIQ_AXONSERVER_STANDALONE=true - AXONIQ_AXONSERVER_DEVMODE_ENABLED=true - AXONIQ_AXONSERVER_HOSTNAME=axonserver - server.servlet.context-path=/ volumes: - ../infra/axon-init:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d - axon_data:/axonserver/data networks: [flashsale-net] healthcheck: test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:8024/actuator/health"] interval: 10s timeout: 5s retries: 10 start_period: 30s
# ================================================================= # 2. RUNNABLE MICROSERVICES # =================================================================
discovery-service: build: context: ./discovery-service dockerfile: Dockerfile container_name: fs-discovery ports: ["8761:8761"] networks: [flashsale-net] healthcheck: test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:8761/actuator/health"] interval: 10s
api-gateway: build: context: ./api-gateway dockerfile: Dockerfile container_name: fs-gateway ports: ["8080:8080"] environment: - EUREKA_URI=${EUREKA_URI} - REDIS_HOST=${REDIS_HOST} depends_on: redis: { condition: service_healthy } discovery-service: { condition: service_healthy } networks: [flashsale-net]
identity-domain: build: context: ./identity-service/identity-domain dockerfile: Dockerfile container_name: fs-identity environment: - EUREKA_URI=${EUREKA_URI} - DB_HOST=${DB_HOST} - DB_NAME_IDENTITY=${DB_NAME_IDENTITY} - POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER} - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD} - AXON_SERVER=${AXON_SERVER} depends_on: postgres: { condition: service_healthy } axonserver: { condition: service_healthy } discovery-service: { condition: service_healthy } networks: [flashsale-net]
product-domain: build: context: ./product-service/product-domain dockerfile: Dockerfile container_name: fs-product environment: - EUREKA_URI=${EUREKA_URI} - MONGO_HOST=${MONGO_HOST} - PRODUCT_DB_NAME=${PRODUCT_DB_NAME} - KAFKA_SERVER=${KAFKA_SERVER} - AXON_SERVER=${AXON_SERVER} - MINIO_URL=${MINIO_URL} depends_on: mongo: { condition: service_healthy } kafka: { condition: service_healthy } axonserver: { condition: service_healthy } discovery-service: { condition: service_healthy } networks: [flashsale-net]
order-domain: build: context: ./order-service/order-domain dockerfile: Dockerfile container_name: fs-order environment: - EUREKA_URI=${EUREKA_URI} - DB_HOST=${DB_HOST} - DB_NAME_ORDER=${DB_NAME_ORDER} - POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER} - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD} - KAFKA_SERVER=${KAFKA_SERVER} - AXON_SERVER=${AXON_SERVER} depends_on: postgres: { condition: service_healthy } axonserver: { condition: service_healthy } discovery-service: { condition: service_healthy } networks: [flashsale-net]
product-domain: build: context: . dockerfile: product-service/product-domain/Dockerfile container_name: fs-product environment: - EUREKA_URI=${EUREKA_URI} - DB_HOST=${DB_HOST} - DB_NAME_PAYMENT=${DB_NAME_PAYMENT} - POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER} - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD} - AXON_SERVER=${AXON_SERVER} depends_on: postgres: { condition: service_healthy } axonserver: { condition: service_healthy } discovery-service: { condition: service_healthy } networks: [flashsale-net]
flashsale-service: build: context: ./flashsale-service dockerfile: Dockerfile container_name: fs-flashsale environment: - EUREKA_URI=${EUREKA_URI} - REDIS_HOST=${REDIS_HOST} - KAFKA_SERVER=${KAFKA_SERVER} depends_on: redis: { condition: service_healthy } kafka: { condition: service_healthy } discovery-service: { condition: service_healthy } networks: [flashsale-net]
search-service: build: context: ./search-service dockerfile: Dockerfile container_name: fs-search environment: - EUREKA_URI=${EUREKA_URI} - ELASTIC_URI=http://elasticsearch:9200 - KAFKA_SERVER=${KAFKA_SERVER} depends_on: elasticsearch: { condition: service_healthy } kafka: { condition: service_healthy } discovery-service: { condition: service_healthy } networks: [flashsale-net]
notification-service: build: context: ./notification-service dockerfile: Dockerfile container_name: fs-notification environment: - EUREKA_URI=${EUREKA_URI} - MONGO_HOST=${MONGO_HOST} - KAFKA_SERVER=${KAFKA_SERVER} depends_on: mongo: { condition: service_healthy } kafka: { condition: service_healthy } discovery-service: { condition: service_healthy } networks: [flashsale-net]
worker-service: build: context: ./woker-service dockerfile: Dockerfile container_name: fs-worker environment: - EUREKA_URI=${EUREKA_URI} - DB_HOST=${DB_HOST} - DB_NAME_WORKER=${DB_NAME_WORKER} - POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER} - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD} - KAFKA_SERVER=${KAFKA_SERVER} - AXON_SERVER=${AXON_SERVER} depends_on: postgres: { condition: service_healthy } kafka: { condition: service_healthy } axonserver: { condition: service_healthy } discovery-service: { condition: service_healthy } networks: [flashsale-net]
cart-service: build: context: . dockerfile: ./cart-service/Dockerfile container_name: fs-cart environment: - EUREKA_URI=${EUREKA_URI} - REDIS_HOST=${REDIS_HOST:-redis} - REDIS_PASSWORD=${REDIS_PASSWORD} depends_on: redis: { condition: service_healthy } discovery-service: { condition: service_healthy } networks: [flashsale-net]
